name: power-platform-skills
tagline_zh: 在 Claude 或 Copilot 里直接建 Power Platform 应用，不用切窗口。装好就能用。
tagline_en: Build Power Platform apps inside Claude or Copilot without switching tabs. Install, then deploy—no doc digging.
desc_en: A plugin marketplace for Claude Code/GitHub Copilot that provides Power Platform development plugins, including reusable skills, agents, and commands for building and deploying solutions.
why_zh: 同类插件多只给代码片段，它却把部署流程也封装成命令，从建到发一条龙。
why_en: Unlike snippet-only plugins, it wraps deployment into commands—build to ship in one flow.
